en: The Cultist does not go to the void when defeated. You can defeat the Cultist any number of times each turn.
zh: 邪教徒被击败后不会进入虚空区。每回合可以任意次数击败邪教徒。

en:
Return to the world of Vigil as the Muses of Malevolence rise to bring ruin. Legendary Heroes from Ascension’s past have returned to guide you, granting their power to those who prove worthy.

Each card you acquire or defeat grants Renown with its factions, advancing you on the Legendary Track. As your Renown grows, unlock powerful Boons from Legendary Characters and, at the pinnacle of a faction’s track, gain Legendry status with the power to acquire or defeat one card from that faction for free each turn.

Includes 86 unique
new cards.
zh:
重返祈夜：恶意缪斯崛起，欲将一切引向毁灭。创升纪元往昔的传奇英雄再度现身，将力量授予证明自己配得上的人。

你获取或击败的每张牌都会为其派系带来声望，推动你在传奇轨道上前进。声望提升后，可解锁传奇角色的强大恩赐；抵达某派系轨道顶点时，获得传奇地位，每回合可免费获取或击败一张该派系卡牌。

包含 86 张独特新卡。

en:
Dark forces have taken over the Dreamscape. Team up with Pasythea, collect her legendary weapons, and return order to her world!

Use the Insight resources and Dreamborn cards to save the Dreamscape. Bind Monsters to your deck and use them in battle! Transform cards to incredible heroes and Constructs and acquire Pasythea! Pair Deliverance with Dreamscape and Delirium for an even more exciting game!

Includes 51 unique
new cards.

新卡。

en:
Delirium brings players back into the Dreamscape, facing a twisted new reality.

Insight and Dreamborn cards are back, but with new powers to unlock with them.

Win Fate Auctions, Recur hero effects, and roll the amazing Delirium Die with your Insight to gain an edge against the other players!

Includes 49 unique new cards.
zh:
「谵妄」将玩家带回梦境，面对扭曲的新现实。

洞察与梦生卡回归，并带来全新可解锁的力量。

赢得天命拍卖、复发英雄效果，再用洞察掷出谵妄骰，抢占对其他玩家的优势！

包含 49 张独特新卡。

en:
* New dual-cost Heroes and Constructs require players to use both resources to acquire them, but have incredible power!
*As the balance between Light and Dark shifts, cards gain additional powers depending on whether it is Night or Day.
